svg.title: One workflow page, with optional details
svg.desc: Start here on Home. Choose both files before Continue to review creates the check. The same workflow page shows Add documents, Check details, and See results. The current phase opens in place. Optional read-only details have a Return to workflow button. Opening a phase never confirms values.

g.text: One place to finish the job
Illustration of the flow. Your files and saved work stay in the system.
Home: Start here
Choose Start with my files, or Continue saved work.
Your invoice check — the same page
All 3 phases stay visible. The current phase opens here.
1. Add documents
Choose files to upload, or use saved invoice + PO.
Continue to review creates the check and saves the pair.
2. Check details
Check invoice, then PO. Save each review.
3. See results
Read differences and evidence. Record a decision.
Details, if needed
A separate reading view.
No edits. No new comparison.
Return to workflow
Go back to your place.
Moving around does not confirm values.
Missing facts stay visible. Earlier results keep their original evidence.
